capabilities: Read EPUB, FB2 and PDF books in a paged one- or two-column layout with themes and typography controls
Highlight passages in four colours, attach comments, and turn highlights into notes or export them by chapter
Store paragraph-anchored reading progress as vault files that ride existing sync services
Browse a visual library grid with covers, progress and categories
Translate or AI-explain a selected passage via Google Translate or a chosen AI provider (off by default)
disambiguation: Not an Amazon Kindle sync tool; it reads EPUB, FB2 and PDF files directly in Obsidian with a Kindle-inspired look.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalog; install manually or via BRAT. Works fully offline except the opt-in translation and AI features. Feedback goes through a Telegram bot; donations accepted. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Kindle-reader is based on Book Reader by Elton, which provided the original URL import base. This project was substantially rewritten and extended
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read e-books, so readers must switch to separate apps and manually move highlights and quotes into their notes.
